meta.description: Registry for recurrence-basin stability classes and boundary conditions in Phase 3.

basin_classes.meaning: A basin that attracts and retains all admissible states under infinite iteration.
A basin that retains states within a bounded neighborhood.
Basin stability depends on specific residue accumulation or saturation levels.
Basin stability depends on rigid orientation-frame alignment.
A basin that retains states temporarily but permits escape under perturbation.

boundary_conditions.name: admissibility_reentry
boundary_conditions.description: Iterative application must map the state back into the current admissibility window.

boundary_conditions.name: residue_damping
boundary_conditions.description: Residue update must provide enough damping to prevent divergence.

boundary_conditions.name: orientation_minimization_lock
boundary_conditions.description: Orientation minimization must consistently select states within the basin boundary.
